INDUSTRIAL PROPERTY (AMENDMENT)
REGULATIONS 2010
INDUSTRIAL PROPERTY ACT 1994
IN EXERCISE of the powers conferred by section 44 of the Industrial
Property Act 1994, the Minister of Labour, Commerce and Industries with the
consent of Cabinet, makes the following Regulations -
1 Short Title
These Regulations may be cited as the Industrial Property (Amendment) Regulations
2010.
2 First Schedule Repealed and Replaced
The First Schedule of the Industrial Property Regulations 1998, is repealed and
replaced with the following -
